I can't do voice conversations - I'm a text-based AI assistant. I can only read and respond to written messages like this one. 

If you're looking for voice interaction, you might want to try voice assistants like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa. But here in this chat, I can help you with anything you'd like to discuss through text! What would you like to talk about?
